headline: Growth accelerates as margins broaden across the board
summary_short: Medtronic revenue reached $9.81B, up 14.3% y/y and 8.8% q/q; diluted EPS was $0.96, up 18.5% y/y and 7.9% q/q, while net income rose to $1.24B (+19.6% y/y, +8.8% q/q).
summary_long: Revenue was $9.81B, up 14.3% y/y and 8.8% q/q. Operating margin expanded to 20.5%, up ~369bp y/y and ~276bp q/q, while gross margin was 65.4% (-202bp y/y, +151bp q/q). EBITDA was $2.73B (+19.8% y/y, +16.8% q/q). Net income was $1.24B (+19.6% y/y, +8.8% q/q); net margin ~12.7%, roughly flat q/q. EPS was $0.97 basic / $0.96 diluted, up ~19-20% y/y and ~8-9% q/q.
